The kill-criterion-of-record is now the SAME-SHAPE comparison: AXIOM fused GEMM at (m=4096,n=512,k=14336) vs llama.cpp Q4_K MUL_MAT at the IDENTICAL (m=4096,n=512,k=14336). Verified against llamacpp_raw.txt:174 (q4_K n=512 = 101.00 TFLOPS, 60.13 GFLOP/run) — the pinned same-shape line exists and is exactly 101.00. The n==1 GEMV (llamacpp_raw.txt:24 = 7.39 TFLOPS, verified) is DEMOTED to a labeled cross_shape_context block ('cross-shape, NOT the kill criterion') and is NEVER the headline nor the within-15% input. m34_emit.py headline_ratio = axc_fused_tflops / M34_LLAMA_SAMESHAPE_TFLOPS(101.00); the n=1 line is parsed only into M34_LLAMA_GEMV_CONTEXT_TFLOPS. The honest expected result is stated as AXIOM ~10-25 TFLOPS / 101 → ~4-10x BEHIND, explicitly 'a massive improvement from M3.4's ~87,000x but STILL behind — NOT spun as a win' (summary, design_principle 5, technical_spec §3, AT-1774, design_md_additions §3.1.20, self_check.honest_expected_result). kill_criterion_within_15pct = false (AXIOM behind), reported honestly. CRITICAL-2 (oracle accumulation precision) — RESOLVED & VERIFIED. The GPU coopmat accumulator is CONFIRMED f16 by direct read of matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:122-125 (matrix[f16, 16, 16, accumulator] for acc_00/01/10/11), reused verbatim by the fused kernel. The r1 oracle (common_q4km_f16ref.rs::q4km_dequant_matmul_f16accum_cpu) now ACCUMULATES IN f16 to MATCH: dequant in f32 exactly as ggml/M2.6, round each weight AND each x activation f32->f16->f32 (half-crate RNE, matching OpFConvert RNE), then walk K in depth-16 coopmat tiles and round the running accumulator to f16 after each tile add. The frozen 1e-3 (AT-1520/AT-1521 value) is NOT loosened. Gate-K policy is honest: the within-tol gate is asserted ONLY at the MEASURED provably-1e-3 K (AT-1770 K=256, AT-1771 K=512 if it holds; else cap the gate at the largest passing K and report larger-K max-rel-diff SEPARATELY, never loosen 1e-3). Max-rel-diff is REPORTED at every size in both the tests (AT-1770/1771) and the bench (AT-1772), including un-gated larger-K (768/1024). The f16-accumulator within-tol result is documented as NVIDIA-coopmat-accumulator-SPECIFIC, not a portable guarantee (correctness_oracle, edge_cases, vendor note).

WARNING (activation dtype asymmetry, low risk): the pinned llama line is type_b=f32 while AXIOM's x is readonly_buffer[f16]. This is a precision difference, NOT a shape difference — both sides compute 2*M*N*K MACs at the IDENTICAL (m,n,k)=60.13 GFLOP/run, so the FLOP-normalized TFLOPS ratio is shape-fair. The architect discloses (OQ-5) that ggml-vulkan's coopmat mul_mat path converts the activation to f16 internally, so AXIOM's f16 x matches the actual coopmat kernel path. Disclosed and reasonable; not a flattering shape-swap.
spirv_concerns: No new SPIR-V concern in r1. OpFConvert f32->f16 (RNE default, no FPRoundingMode) is the exact inverse of emit_f16_bits_to_f32's final OpFConvert; needs only Float16 (already in the union). Confirmed in r0; unchanged.
vendor_concerns: The f16-accumulator within-tol result is NVIDIA-coopmat-accumulator-specific (NVIDIA tensor cores may internally accumulate above strict f16). r1 now DOCUMENTS this explicitly (correctness_oracle, edge_cases, vendor note). Tests typed-skip on Lavapipe (CoopMatUnsupported) and subgroup_size()!=32. Acceptable for the NVIDIA-only M3.5 scope; AMD/Intel win remains unproven (as in M3.4).
shape_capability_check: VERIFIED — NO mismatch. AXIOM's fused kernel (derived from matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:90-110) takes M, N, K as runtime u32 parameters and computes the grid as (N/32, M/32, 1) with no hardcoded shape ceiling. For the pinned same-shape (m=4096, n=512, k=14336): grid_x = 512/32 = 16, grid_y = 4096/32 = 128 (both integral), num_k_blocks = 14336/16 = 896 (integral, tile_k=16). All constraints (M,N multiples of 32; K multiple of tile_k=16) are satisfied, so AXIOM's fused kernel CAN actually run the IDENTICAL n=512 shape the llama 101-TFLOPS line uses. The same-shape A/B is genuinely same-shape, not a shape AXIOM cannot run. Shared usage 2048 bytes << 49152 device limit. FLOP parity confirmed: 2*4096*512*14336 = 60.13 GFLOP/run, matching llamacpp_raw.txt:174 exactly.
